generation_fact: One atomic relation established by one concrete execution: source information, realized transformation, concrete occurrence, formed outcome, and relation role.
generation_occurrence: One concrete execution; it can establish several separate generation facts.
atomic_generation_fact: Each fact keeps its exact source, transformation, occurrence, outcome, and role together as one indivisible record.
realizes_fact: Connects an occurrence node to a specific fact that the occurrence established.
reads_from: Records an actual data dependency and must not be inferred from order, time, or value similarity.
GeneratedOrigin: Allows a previously formed outcome to serve as the exact source of a later generation fact.
program_order: Records declared execution order but does not by itself establish a data dependency or concurrency.
equal_values: Equal numeric values do not identify the same fact, occurrence, or result, and equal outputs do not establish equal formation.
cartesian_recombination: Facts from an occurrence must remain separate; their sources and outcomes must not be split into sets and recombined by Cartesian product.
missing_relations: A missing relation means it was not established, not automatically that it is false; in particular, absence of a concurrency edge does not prove concurrency.
forward_query: Follow exact identities along training sample -> batch occurrence -> forward occurrence -> loss -> backward occurrence -> gradient -> optimizer occurrence -> new parameter version.
reverse_query: Start from an evaluation or parameter result and traverse its actual reads_from, GeneratedOrigin, realizes_fact, and incidence relations; never substitute timestamp proximity or numeric similarity.
